> Is there a way to show custom messages when the package is released?
>
> After releasing, we need to manually run `yarn run release-templates` in the [Create InstantSearch App](https://github.com/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/blob/4a65aabdbcd407de2f1cc64527b721ed9704d3cf/package.json#L27) repo so that sandboxes are updated with latest InstantSearch versions. It'd be nice to mention that once it's released.
